title: Prerequisite Sprint Map
user: A learner beginning a technical subject who needs the smallest prerequisite set, practice, and an immediate start on the target topic.
smallest_useful_product: Static web/PWA planner with editable prerequisite nodes, diagnostic checks, target-date capacity math, and a visible start-now lane.
success_measure: 65% of users complete a target-topic exercise before every optional prerequisite node.
constraints: State assumptions per template; never imply universal sufficiency; collect no minors' educational data.
